audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with the whys under them — Level 1 was Skill against a 'Warwick-favoured' why, Level 2 was Warwick against a 'Skill' why, Level 6 was Skill against a 'Warwick-favoured' why, and 2+ items was Warwick against a 'Zac-favoured' why. Rows 3 and 5 additionally disagreed with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: Zac's blob healing decides the middle of the lane: Warwick wins the stages where Elastic Slingshot (21s at rank 1) is spent and the blobs are denied, Zac takes over once a health item lets the blobs reset every trade, and fully built he is an engage tank Warwick cannot duel.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Warwick / Skill / Warwick / Skill / Warwick / Zac / Zac as matched full+content pairs. Rows 3 and 5 follow the mirror (Levels 4-5 Skill, First item Zac) rather than the packet, and whys[3] and whys[5] are rewritten so both layers say the same thing.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why sold Warwick's Blade of the Ruined King and two-item side lane on rows that belong to Zac, and phases[4].why said nothing about what actually changes at 6.
audit.why: Zac's health item is the earlier spike because Cell Division's blob pickups scale with it, and Let's Bounce! (120/105/90) is a teamfight tool rather than a duel tool — the real level-6 caveat for Warwick is that a killing blow splits Zac into four bloblets that revive him.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the bloblet revive, phases[5].why the blob-reset problem, phases[6].why the engage-tank ceiling and where to spend R.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere, the passive revive was never stated, and the Warwick-side interaction the mirror found — Blood Hunt extending his own R — was absent.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s, the longest window in the lane and the moment to fight. Unstable Matter is a flat 5s and deals a percentage of MAX HEALTH, so stacking raw HP against him is wrong. Cell Division sheds reabsorbable chunks on every ability hit and revives him from four bloblets on a killing blow — walking over the blobs is the whole win condition. On Warwick's side, Blood Hunt grants move speed toward targets below 50% and Infinite Duress's leap scales with bonus move speed, so being low actually extends his suppress range; Primal Howl is 2.5s of damage reduction first and a fear second, on 15s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d carries the 21s rank-1 Slingshot window; dosFull[1].d states the Blood Hunt / R-range interaction; dontsFull[0].d states blob denial; dontsFull[1].d states Unstable Matter's 5s and max-health damage; tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d re-keyed to Primal Howl's damage reduction and cooldown.

audit.why: The kit's derived flags put 'grounding' on Elastic Slingshot, but Riot's own description is only 'Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward' — no grounding effect. Per the calibration rule I trusted the description and did not tell the player his Q lunge or R leap can be grounded by it.
audit.corrected: No edit made; recorded here and in notes.
